articles.headline: New signing Carlos Baleba gets 1st Man United outing in friendly
articles.description: Carlos Baleba played his first minutes in a Manchester United shirt during a behind-closed-doors friendly on Friday.

articles.headline: Erik ten Hag 'was a piece of crap' with Man United squad - Fred

articles.headline: Sir Alex Ferguson on David Beckham's Preston loan: 'He thought I wanted him gone but that's not true'

articles.description: Fulham boss Alvaro Arbeloa has been charged with misconduct by the FA  for claiming officials would "not let Manchester United lose" after Michael Carrick's side scored a late equaliser to draw their Premier League match at Craven Cottage.

articles.headline: Man United selling chunks of Old Trafford pitch
articles.description: Old Trafford -- the home of Manchester United -- has seen plenty of history over the years. Now, fans can own a piece of the pitch ...for £125 ($165).

articles.headline: Man United transfer strategy 'financial sustainable' as losses increase - CEO
